category: NOORDER - SELECT SINGLE on a partial key

category: NOORDER - cluster/pool table or cursor without ORDER BY

category: NOORDER - READ TABLE BINARY SEARCH without SORT

category: NOORDER - DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, AT NEW, ON CHANGE OF
fix: SORT before the loop on exactly the compared fields (plain SORT if none), placed outside any loop.

category: NOORDER - first-row access (READ INDEX 1, LOOP with EXIT)

category: NOORDER - WRITE/EXIT/RETURN inside a SELECT loop

category: NOORDER on a FOR ALL ENTRIES SELECT
